Good afternoon. My order ID is ORD-22006. 

I actually received the delivery today, but the delivery person handed me a box that was visibly crushed. In fact, I could hear broken pieces rattling around inside the box. I took photos of the condition of the box before opening it, just to be safe. 

Could you please check the delivery status and arrange a replacement shipment or a refund for these carrier-damaged goods? Kindly do the needful at the earliest.
